BLOCKCRAFT
Punch trees!

VR headset not detected — open this build in a WebXR headset browser (e.g. Meta Quest Browser) over https.

VR controls: Left stick: move / click for sprint or flight boost · Right stick: turn / select
Right trigger: hold to mine / attack · Right grip: place / use
A: jump / fly up · B: fly down · Right stick click: creative flight
X: inventory / crafting · Point at wrist + trigger: equip · Y: crouch

Audio credits

Animal recordings embedded in this game: Cow — Secretlondon / OpenGameArt, CC BY-SA 3.0; the cow audio and its playback adaptations remain under that licence. Pig SFX — Vinrax and Chicken — IMadeIt, CC BY 3.0. Sheep — mikewest / AntumDeluge, Dog vocals — pauliuw, Rabbit — Voltiment555, and Horse — BigSoundBank #0460, CC0. Clips are volume-normalised; rabbit/dog excerpts are trimmed and resampled; hurt and fantasy calls use pitch/filter adaptations.

Monster voices: ArcadeParty; snarls: Darsycho; bones: AntumDeluge. All CC0; playback adapted with pitch, filtering and normalization.
